Vaswani_2017_Attention.title: Attention Is All You Need
Vaswani_2017_Attention.conference: 31st Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2017), Long Beach, CA, USA

formulas.scaled_dot_product_attention: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax((Q * K^T) / sqrt(d_k)) * V
formulas.multi_head_attention: MultiHead(Q, K, V) = Concat(head_1, ..., head_h) * W^O
formulas.head_i: head_i = Attention(Q * W_i^Q, K * W_i^K, V * W_i^V)

Pressman_Software_Engineering.title: Software Engineering: A Practitioner's Approach
Pressman_Software_Engineering.author: Roger S. Pressman, Ph.D.
Pressman_Software_Engineering.core_subject: Kỹ nghệ phần mềm và quản lý vòng đời phát triển phần mềm cổ điển/hiện đại
main_parts: Part 1: The Product and the Process (Software process models, Waterfall, Incremental, RAD, Evolutionary, Component-based)
Part 2: Managing Software Projects (Project management concepts, Estimation, Risk management, Quality management)

Part 3: Conventional Methods for Software Engineering (System engineering, Analysis concepts, Requirements analysis, Design concepts, Architectural design, User interface design, Software testing techniques)
Part 4: Object-Oriented Software Engineering (OO analysis, OO design, OO testing, Technical metrics)
Part 5: Advanced Topics in Software Engineering (Formal methods, Cleanroom software engineering, Component-based development, Reengineering, Client/server software engineering)
